name: Mansio (official inn)

period: late 3rd century AD (c. 270–280): as excavated (Fox & St John Hope 1894), with the undated west-wing alterations

conventions: walls: centreline a->b, thickness t, height h; openings at metres from a, width w, height oh. conjecture:true marks things not evidenced (heights, roofs, most doors).

rooms.name: Granary
rooms.note: "probably a granary, measuring 60 by 30 ft, with stoutly buttressed west wall and several smaller chambers" (Boon 1957)

rooms.name: 1 Hot room

rooms.name: 4 Reservoir
rooms.note: spring-fed reservoir, 6 ft square inside, paved with heavy tiles (Boon 1957); walls 3 ft 4 in, lined with brick (Hilton Price 1887)

rooms.name: 5 Apodyterium

rooms.name: 8 (recess)
rooms.note: western recess of No. 8 with a hypocaust of horizontal box-tile flues (Hilton Price 1887)
